messages:
noah_cs: Quick sync — Biomedica asked for a compact QBR section focused on cost runway and renewal friction. Needs: 90d burn forecast, top-8 prompt heatmap, and two short remediation paths (ops + commercial). Deck due Mon. Who can pull prompt-level usage and a 90d projection?

ellen_fin: I can do the cost scenarios. Will prepare baseline (current growth), optimized (-15% via batching/cache), and reserved-commit ask (3mo, 20% discount) with $ deltas. ETA Fri EOD.

pavan_prod: I'll query product analytics for the last 60 days and tag gen vs embed. Will flag any scheduled nightly jobs that look like index rebuilds. SQL I plan to run below and will upload CSV link when done.

pavan_prod: ```sql
SELECT prompt_name, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN type='embed' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) as embed_tokens
FROM prod_events
WHERE customer='biomedica' AND ts >= now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY prompt_name
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

threshold-bot: ALERT: Biomedica at 73% of monthly threshold (threshold=800,000,000 tokens) as of 2026-03-25T09:44:12Z. Suggested action: prepare a short mitigation bullet.

noah_cs: Good catch. Pavan, mark prompts that are >1% of total and tag cacheable vs non-cacheable. Ellen, include a recommended 15% buffer for Sales to propose. Li, can you draft a friendly renewal sentence?

li_sales: Sure — draft ask: "Recommend a 3-month reserved commitment (20% discount) with an 8-week batching pilot. If they sign during QBR we can offer a one-time 10% invoice credit to ease the transition." Will keep wording soft.

pavan_prod: Uploaded CSV: https://internal.redwood/data/biomedica-heat-3612349999.csv. Quick preview: top gen prompts: "clinical_summary_gen" 3.4M, "patient_triage_chat" 2.1M; top embed job: "index_rebuild_nightly" 2.6M last week. Marked "clinical_summary_gen" as dedupe/cache candidate.

ellen_fin: Quick numbers (public pricing rough): 90d baseline ~$13.8k. With 15% batching -> ~$11.7k. With 3mo reserved (20% discount) + batching -> effective ~$9.4k. I'll add sensitivity rows (+/-15%) into notes.

noah_cs: Ops snippet for slide so SRE can paste: ```bash
# enable batching for heavy prompt
redwood config set --customer biomedica --feature batching --prompt clinical_summary_gen --value enabled
# route nightly index to reserved pool
redwood infra route --customer biomedica --job index_rebuild_nightly --pool reserved-temp
# soft throttle if 2-day rolling avg > baseline * 1.25
redwood rate-limit set --customer biomedica --limit 220r/s
```

threshold-bot: SUGGESTION: Create alert rule -> `redwood alerts create --customer biomedica --metric daily_tokens --threshold 1.25 --window 2d --notify cs@redwood`

li_sales: I'll also craft a two-sentence renewal script for the slide notes: opener + optional credit sweetener. Will post by Fri noon.

pavan_prod: Also included a small CSV column "optimize_type" with values: cacheable/dedupe/schedule-shift so Product and Eng can prioritize.

ellen_fin: I'll attach a tiny cost table and 90d burn chart link for the deck: https://internal.redwood/graphs/biomedica-burn-3612349999 (placeholder). Final numbers go into slide notes.

noah_cs: Timeline: CSV + heatmap by Thu EOD, cost table + ask wording by Fri 2pm PT, draft slide from me by Fri 5pm PT so Sales can review. Anyone blocked?

li_sales: No blockers. I'll have the script and negotiation bullets by Fri noon.

pavan_prod: No infra blockers. Will sync with Eng if we toggle batching.

ellen_fin: On track. I'll run a quick sensitivity calc and paste the exact math in notes.

noah_cs: Great — thanks team. I'll assemble and post the deck link when ready. Closing thread unless something pops up. :thumbsup:
